title: Prove the scoped 112-call standalone fanout optimum (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Give a matching construction and written lower bound for the standalone interface

```
y_p += (q^-1 W_s h)_p, p=0..111,
h_0,...,h_7 strictly unchanged at every instruction.
```

The construction uses **112 paid H1 calls**, 672 ADDs, 344 monomial maps, 8 COPYs, 249 CLEARs and 249 zero-retags. Seventeen owned fields have arbitrary entry values and return zero. There are no runtime odd divisions and no query reduction. The exact 112-row source classification has 112 singleton classes, each of rational row rank one.

The accompanying written proof establishes **112 TOTAL Gaussian field calls** in its declared standalone grammar, matching this upper bound. It allows later paid calls to consume earlier responses. Its hypotheses remain essential: one fixed finite exact program, fixed exterior coefficients, a finite columnwise ordinary group, the same program on every positive width or one consecutive integer-width tail, ordinary initial span only, fixed common field capacity, arbitrary independent original inputs, the retained scalar-row/shared-right-factor structure, and one field-output row per paid call.

This is **not 112 additional calls at a global cut**. Existing Gaussian/native/cached initial observations, changed capacities or multiple outputs per charge, inter-column operations, width-dependent/growing programs, restricted width subsequences, approximate/nonlinear/antilinear computations and projective-phase identities lie outside the theorem. It supplies no complete caller, physical raw dual, weighted recursive invoice, compiler/precision/stock admission or new κ.

## Task and overlap

The explicit donor assignment and coordinated owner request change the pinned `independent-moment` card to this source-bound construction/optimality/verification package; `TASK.json` records that scope change. It identifies a precise limit on standalone fanout work so that caller research can investigate genuinely different premises, including actual pre-existing observations, with complete accounting.

Canonical provenance is `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`, selected conditional κ `.003027288235` under the same five assumptions. The upper checker, its six consumed dependencies, original program/result and module proof are retained unchanged with explicit LOCAL provenance and owner publication permission. Canonical metadata/Merkle origins do not turn those generated files into canonical ancestors. The source provider lineage includes #5402; #5423 and #5424 are distinct coordinated component and budget contributions. No new standalone census, competing constructor or reinterpretation of their price allowances is introduced here.

Pre-submission all-author coverage through 08:46:47 UTC found no new competing source/fanout/price submission; main, selected record and guidance were unchanged. Discussion-only and unpublished work are not exhaustively covered. Existing ownership coordination is retained, and this result does not reserve another contributor's caller work.

## Validation

The original unchanged checker is `b824bf066999887b96fc386678ce44fb2269dc30406b06d65a9aac43a0437ae3`. Its complete RESULT is `bf29a13f9e7ef9feb87befcc71b6919ed75726e6fef87b139e0c9c6ad244cdb7`; complete PROGRAM is `5575fc71eb94f1b75b3421d787d3313716ece5e72d3498ce348500f3628291f7` (1,282,103 bytes). The written module proof is retained at `cfa9f3df855f96a3e73bcb8042a750a3aa41d18ec098d6a34268370f3e84d782`.

The 57,344 column comparisons check **112 singleton SELF-alias operators on 512 addresses each**. They are not a fresh 137-field physical endpoint replay. Forward endpoint correctness is compositional: pinned Kp/Km words and exact phase conventions, integer factorization/recovery certificates, one exterior 1/2, literal ADD segments and source/owned lifetimes. The native factor2 is not counted again in Km, and exterior coefficients are not tensor-powered. Thirteen original controls reject phase, ordering, alias, coefficient, scalar-lift and lifetime mutations.

Independent static review accepts the upper construction under its pinned premises. A separate static proof review accepts the lower argument: all-width Vandermonde faithfulness, finite ordinary-module history dimension even with feedback/overwrites, a CENTRAL scalar right inverse followed only by cancellation of an invertible group element, and disjoint coset supports. No ordinary ring-domain assumption is made; zero divisors are allowed. The consecutive-tail corollary uses shifted Vandermonde powers. This is a written proof and independent mathematical reading, **not a formal-kernel or numerical verification of the lower theorem**. The wrapper authenticates and scopes the proof; it does not execute it as a theorem checker.

Four authorized fresh upper-checker replays passed in three serial 30-second/256-MiB requests: registered normal/optimized pair **8.757609s, 88,203,264 sampled peak bytes**; readonly normal **4.230012s, 57,831,424B**; readonly optimized **4.637756s, 62,660,608B**. All four complete PROGRAMs and RESULTs match the frozen originals in **full raw bytes AND typed JSON, with ZERO exclusions**. The wrapper's ten controls also reject forged source/proof evidence, global/incremental or cached-history promotion, unsupported widths/capacity, false physical-replay claims and numeric-type substitutions. These augment the thirteen controls in the original upper checker.

Full fresh PROGRAMs are retained through lossless zlib+base64 transport. Bounded strict decoding checks length, EOF, no unused/unconsumed tails, raw SHA and exact uncompressed bytes. Compression is only transport; no compressed-container hash determines scientific equality. Full small RESULTs remain UTF-8. All eight fresh artifacts are publicly reconstructible from the passive raw capsule.

The 67 actual pinned files comprise 32 working sources, 32 readonly copies, runner, guard and source freeze. Actual peer pre/post custody and independent current readbacks match; the new current readback has its own UTC provenance and is not presented as an independently captured historical post-run snapshot. All 23 readonly directory modes match. Portable sources were 0444/directories 0555 with empty PATH, absolute Python and an explicit Git-discovery ceiling/probe exit 128; ancestor Git metadata was preserved.

Two passive artifacts sit OUTSIDE the 32 executed package sources and source export: the exact peer summary `certificates/research/fanout-optimality-package-validation-v1.json` (SHA256 `7a2f4a2df8b3e26d5fe7a5a158617ad49775507aa86edf367c6ba71168b1c4a9`), and the raw logs/custody capsule `certificates/research/fanout-optimality-replay-evidence-v1.json` (SHA256 `dc7568800ae38877a8ef3bdf6608dd7da7f567bd6af63297536698714b974f4d`, 441,469 bytes). The latter retains all three actual logs/guards, exact original pre-inventory/post-summary and all four transport events; it was built AFTER execution and is not an executed input. Frozen preparation-status prose is historical; these actual records supersede pending status without changing tested source.

Science/evidence commit: `82cd2a2e4d74314d4c03ad57a6d2ce1374731f75`, direct parent canonical 1a3. Publication head: `00005c8c5e81c7f27b5769f9309ff88758e26f51`. The 34 science/evidence paths are 32 source files plus two passive records; the sole extra publication file is the exact previously reviewed #5420/#5423/#5424 `docs/ci-verification.md` repair. There are 35 total PR paths. Metadata, committed-byte and declared-source-history checks pass at both commits. The canonical commit graph has 7507 commits; a complete file-corpus checkout or historical mathematical replay is not claimed.

Official source export/check passes: SHA256 `3193c986695817a2a261dd91c7c41a2cd5ddbab87f702623092d212ae5116e86`, 2,385,920 bytes, 33 members comprising 32 payloads plus one transport receipt. All 32 payloads match the tested working/readonly source, both commits and export. Both passive records match separately and are not exported. Working 0644, readonly 0444/directories 0555, Git 100644 and export 0644 are distinct representation modes. The final archive was **not separately rerun**. [Registered package](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/00005c8c5e81c7f27b5769f9309ff88758e26f51/research/fanout-optimality-support); [public raw evidence capsule](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/00005c8c5e81c7f27b5769f9309ff88758e26f51/certificates/research/fanout-optimality-replay-evidence-v1.json).

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fanout-optimality-support
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/fanout-optimality-support --check-source-history
```

Direct portable replay is `/usr/bin/python3 -I -Werror -B verify.py`, adding `-O` for optimized mode. The hook runs only the unchanged upper checker and its required phase oracle in a fresh original-path sandbox. It does not overwrite expected artifacts, run an additional classifier/native/provider/price/Lean engine, execute the source-assessor reviews or formally verify the lower proof. First hosted run [40080072002](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40080072002), attempt 1, passed at exact publication head `00005c8c5e81c7f27b5769f9309ff88758e26f51` (completed 2026-10-24 09:04:13 UTC). Plan job `120831602950` passed onboarding and package selection; replay job `120832351858` passed the bounded normal/optimized package replay and unchanged-input check. Both modes matched complete PROGRAM and RESULT in raw bytes and typed JSON with zero exclusions, with thirteen original controls and ten wrapper controls. Hosted CI preserves the stated standalone scope and static lower-proof boundary; it establishes no incremental global bound or new κ.

## Open next questions

1. Which actual Gaussian/native observations are available at the relevant caller cut, with exact owners, phases, axes, chronological versions and last-read/CLEAR times? First provide a literal prefix and its complete bill. Such a changed initial module lies outside this standalone lower bound; a symbolic Gaussian factor alone is not a reusable response.
2. Can a changed consumer preserve all independent Gaussian targets and retire every coupled bank within its full paid/target/ordinary budget? Start with a single source-bound joint word and return/restoration proof; this package provides neither that caller nor its raw dual.
3. Can an alternative using non-columnwise operations, width-dependent work or a changed capacity be implemented affordably? It needs a new explicit resource and compiler contract, not an extension of this restricted theorem. The relevant physical, ordinary, precision/stock and funding obligations remain open.
